question: Find the volume of a solid hemisphere whose radius is 6.3 cm.(Use π=22/7)
solution:
**Given:-**

radius = 6.3 cm

**To find:-**

The volume of a solid hemisphere

**Formula used:-**

 Volume = (2)/(3)pi r³

Calculation**:-**

Radius (r) = 6.3 cm

By using the formula of volume of the solid hemisphere,

⇒ Volume = (2)/(3)pi r³

⇒ Volume = (2)/(3)pi (6.3)³

⇒ V=(2)/(3)times(22)/(7)times(6.3)times(6.3)times(6.3)

⇒ V = 523.908 cm3 

**The volume of solid hemisphere is 523.908 cm3 **
